declaration.population: all 288 resolved markets per day, 2592 per arm/timing; identical flat starting state
declaration.selection: all nine consumed dates, fixed guards trained on eight; exploratory historical comparison
declaration.reduce_reserved: original adding policy; reducing desired/submitted quantities capped to max(0,abs(known net)-all same-side remaining reservations)
declaration.both_reserved: same reducing policy plus adding cap max(0,10-signed known net-all same-side remaining reservations)
declaration.reservations: resting, pending creates, pending cancels; size minus reported fills; deduplicate order identity; no opposite-side credit
declaration.cancellation: new arms reserve through simulated cancellation confirmation plus 100ms fill-report delay plus .001ms event-order cushion; no credit from unreported actual fills
declaration.retention: new arms keep eligible same-price reducing orders if known remainder fits desired quantity and aggregate budget; both_reserved also does so for adding orders
declaration.allocation: existing reservations first; new orders in lane order 0,1,2,3; recheck on send; floor .01 and enforce existing >=1 share/$1 rules
declaration.unchanged: all price guards, RO60/S240, original size maximum, execution/latency/queue models, no taker or urgency
limits: reduce_reserved retains soft adding-side CAP10 and cannot promise a global 10-share bound
both_reserved aims for actual absolute inventory <=10 in the simulated lifecycle; checked on every fill
changes include partial-order retention and conservative post-cancel reservation grace; not isolated to a single arithmetic term
realized turnover not matched; report per-share markout and volume; no pure execution-quality claim
no own market impact or full live OMS; no independent validation or deployment claim
declaration.reference_reuse: fresh baseline and reserved10 on first full day J/X plus eight-market smoke; other days copied by hash from prior experiment
declaration.attribution: FIFO matching includes price drift, not pure spread; inventory-square is an exposure proxy

null.design: shared paired UTC-day sign flips, sign-invariant RMS max-T, paired day bootstrap
null.family: three declared pairs x J/X x settlement/+1s/inventory-square = 18

declaration.prior_selection: two new variants chosen after entry-budget results; prior entry study had two candidates / 18 comparisons; no threshold sweep

generations.interpretation: identification bounds, not confidence intervals; repeated identical creation timestamps lack unique order IDs
